<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Dream2biz — Everything Academy &amp; Marketplace</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lato:wght@400;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/tabler-icons/2.44.0/iconfont/tabler-icons.min.css">
<style>

  :root{
    --black:#000000; --panel:#0D0D0D; --panel-2:#171717;
    --cream:#FFFFFF; --paper:#F2F2F2;
    --lime:#FFFFFF; --lime-dim:#2A2A2A;
    --coral:#FFFFFF; --coral-dim:#232323;
    --violet:#FFFFFF;
    --line:#262626; --line-2:#333333;
    --muted:#B0B0B0; --muted-2:#707070;
    --display:'Lato', sans-serif;
    --body:'Lato', sans-serif;
    --mono:'Lato', sans-serif;
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
  body{background:var(--black); color:var(--cream); font-family:var(--body); font-weight:700; line-height:1.6; -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}
  img,svg{display:block; max-width:100%;}
  h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--display); font-weight:900; letter-spacing:-0.01em; line-height:1.1;}
  a{color:inherit;}
  button{font-family:var(--body); font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;}

  .eyebrow{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--lime); font-weight:900; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:14px;}
  .eyebrow::before{content:'◆'; font-size:8px; color:var(--coral);}

  .btn-primary{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.04em; background:var(--lime); color:#000000; padding:13px 22px; border-radius:100px; border:1px solid var(--lime); transition:all .15s;}
  .btn-primary:hover{background:transparent; color:var(--lime);}
  .btn-ghost{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--cream); padding:13px 22px; border-radius:100px; border:1.5px solid var(--line-2); background:transparent; transition:all .15s;}
  .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--muted); background:var(--panel);}
  .btn-sm{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.03em; padding:9px 16px; border-radius:100px; border:1.5px solid var(--line-2); background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--cream); transition:all .15s;}
  .btn-sm:hover{border-color:var(--lime); color:var(--lime);}

  .soon{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:900;
    color:var(--coral); border:1.5px dashed var(--coral-dim); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    padding:4px 10px; border-radius:100px;
  }
  .soon::before{content:''; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--coral);}

  /* ===== APP SHELL ===== */
  .shell{display:flex; min-height:100vh;}

  /* ---- sidebar ---- */
  .sidebar{
    width:250px; flex-shrink:0; background:var(--panel); border-right:1px solid var(--line);
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:sticky; top:0; height:100vh; overflow-y:auto;
  }
  .sb-logo{padding:20px 20px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .sb-logo img{height:26px; width:auto; border-radius:5px;}
  .sb-nav{padding:14px 12px; flex:1;}
  .sb-group{margin-bottom:20px;}
  .sb-group-label{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:900; color:var(--muted-2); padding:0 12px; margin-bottom:6px;}
  .sb-link{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; width:100%; text-align:left;
    background:none; border:none; color:var(--muted); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700;
    padding:9px 12px; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:2px; transition:all .12s;
  }
  .sb-link:hover{background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--cream);}
  .sb-link.active{background:var(--lime-dim); color:var(--lime); font-weight:900;}
  .sb-link .dot{width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--coral); opacity:0; transition:opacity .12s;}
  .sb-link.active .dot{opacity:1;}
  .sb-foot{padding:16px 20px; border-top:1px solid var(--line);}
  .sb-foot p{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:10px; font-weight:900; color:var(--muted-2); letter-spacing:.04em;}

  /* ---- top bar ---- */
  .main{flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column;}
  .topbar{
    height:64px; flex-shrink:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:rgba(0,0,0,0.85); backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:0 24px; position:sticky; top:0; z-index:40;
  }
  .search-box{
    flex:1; max-width:420px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius:100px; padding:9px 16px;
  }
  .search-box input{background:none; border:none; outline:none; color:var(--cream); font-family:var(--body); font-weight:700; font-size:13.5px; width:100%;}
  .search-box input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-2);}
  .search-box i{color:var(--muted-2); font-size:16px;}
  .topbar-spacer{flex:1;}
  .icon-btn{
    position:relative; width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:10px; border:1px solid transparent; background:none;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--muted); font-size:19px; transition:all .12s;
  }
  .icon-btn:hover{background:var(--panel-2); color:var(--cream); border-color:var(--line-2);}
  .icon-btn .badge{
    position:absolute; top:5px; right:5px; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--coral); border:2px solid var(--black);
  }
  .avatar{
    width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--lime); color:#000000; font-family:var(--mono); font-weight:900; font-size:13px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:none;
  }

  /* dropdown panels */
  .panel-wrap{position:relative;}
  .dropdown{
    position:absolute; top:48px; right:0; width:320px; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius:14px;
    box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.7); padding:6px; display:none; z-index:50;
  }
  .dropdown.open{display:block;}
  .dd-head{padding:12px 14px 10px; font-family:var(--display); font-weight:900; font-size:14.5px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .dd-body{padding:14px;}
  .dd-item{display:flex; gap:10px; padding:9px 4px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);}
  .dd-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .dd-item .dd-ic{width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:8px; background:var(--panel-2); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--lime); font-size:15px; flex-shrink:0;}
  .dd-item p{font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5;}
  .dd-item p strong{color:var(--cream); font-weight:900;}

  /* ---- content ---- */
  .content{flex:1; padding:44px 40px 80px; max-width:1180px;}
  .page{display:none;}
  .page.active{display:block; animation:fadein .3s ease;}
  @keyframes fadein{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(6px);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}}

  .page-head{max-width:680px; margin-bottom:36px;}
  .page-head h1{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,40px); color:var(--cream); margin-bottom:14px;}
  .page-head p{color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; font-size:15.5px;}
  .page-actions{display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:24px;}

  .grid3{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:18px; margin-top:32px;}
  .grid2{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:18px; margin-top:32px;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .grid3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;} }
  @media (max-width:640px){ .grid3,.grid2{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  .card{background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; padding:22px;}
  .card h3{font-size:16px; color:var(--cream); margin-bottom:8px; font-weight:900;}
  .card p{font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted-2); margin-bottom:14px;}
  .card .card-ic{width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--lime-dim); color:var(--lime); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:14px;}

  .section-sub{margin-top:56px;}
  .section-sub h2{font-size:20px; color:var(--cream); margin-bottom:18px;}

  /* mock list rows (jobs, products, courses etc) */
  .row-list{border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; background:var(--panel);}
  .row-item{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:16px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .row-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .row-thumb{width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:10px; flex-shrink:0;}
  .row-item .ri-title{font-weight:900; color:var(--cream); font-size:14.5px;}
  .row-item .ri-sub{font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted-2); margin-top:2px;}
  .row-item .ri-right{margin-left:auto; text-align:right; flex-shrink:0;}
  .price{font-family:var(--mono); font-weight:900; color:var(--lime); font-size:13.5px;}

  /* pricing cards */
  .pricing-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:18px; margin-top:32px;}
  @media (max-width:900px){ .pricing-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
  .price-card{background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:18px; padding:28px; display:flex; flex-direction:column;}
  .price-card.feat{border-color:var(--lime); background:linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.06), var(--panel) 60%);}
  .price-card .p-tier{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted-2); margin-bottom:10px;}
  .price-card .p-amt{font-family:var(--display); font-size:34px; font-weight:900; color:var(--cream); margin-bottom:4px;}
  .price-card .p-amt span{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px; color:var(--muted-2); font-weight:700;}
  .price-card ul{list-style:none; margin:20px 0 24px; flex:1;}
  .price-card li{font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); padding:7px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2); display:flex; gap:8px;}
  .price-card li:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .price-card li i{color:var(--lime); font-size:15px;}

  /* forms */
  .form-card{background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:18px; padding:32px; max-width:440px;}
  .field{margin-bottom:16px;}
  .field label{display:block; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted-2); margin-bottom:7px;}
  .field input, .field textarea{
    width:100%; background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius:10px; padding:11px 14px;
    color:var(--cream); font-family:var(--body); font-weight:700; font-size:14px; outline:none; transition:border-color .15s;
  }
  .field input:focus, .field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--lime);}
  .field textarea{resize:vertical; min-height:90px;}
  .auth-tabs{display:flex; gap:6px; background:var(--panel-2); border-radius:100px; padding:4px; margin-bottom:24px;}
  .auth-tab{flex:1; text-align:center; padding:9px; border-radius:100px; border:none; background:none; color:var(--muted); font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:900;}
  .auth-tab.active{background:var(--lime); color:#000000;}

  /* terminal / coming-soon block */
  .terminal{background:#050505; border:1px solid var(--line-2); border-radius:14px; overflow:hidden; font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; margin-top:24px;}
  .term-bar{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:10px 14px; background:var(--panel-2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);}
  .term-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;}
  .term-body{padding:16px 18px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; line-height:1.9;}
  .term-body .lime{color:var(--lime);}

  .toast{
    position:fixed; bottom:28px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);
    background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--lime); border-radius:100px; padding:12px 22px;
    font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12.5px; font-weight:900; color:var(--cream); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:all .25s ease; z-index:100; box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
  }
  .toast.show{opacity:1; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}
  .toast i{color:var(--lime); font-size:16px;}

  .mobile-topbar{display:none;}
  @media (max-width:900px){
    .sidebar{position:fixed; left:0; top:0; z-index:60; transform:translateX(-100%); transition:transform .2s;}
    .sidebar.open{transform:translateX(0);}
    .content{padding:28px 20px 60px;}
    .search-box{max-width:none;}
    .mobile-topbar{display:flex;}
  }

  .hero-badges{display:flex; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:26px;}
  .hero-badge{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; font-weight:900; color:var(--muted); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:100px; padding:7px 14px; background:var(--panel);}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="shell">

  <!-- ================= SIDEBAR ================= -->
  <aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
    <div class="sb-logo">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Dream2biz">
    </div>
    <nav class="sb-nav">
      <div class="sb-group">
        <div class="sb-group-label">Overview</div>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="home"><span>Home</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="newsfeed"><span>Newsfeed</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="insights"><span>Insights</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="sb-group">
        <div class="sb-group-label">Learn</div>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="skillup"><span>Skill-Up Hub</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="tutorials"><span>Tutorials</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="elibrary"><span>E-Library</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="sb-group">
        <div class="sb-group-label">Build</div>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="rnd"><span>R&amp;D</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="software"><span>Software Products</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="digiservices"><span>Digi Services</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="workspace"><span>Workspace</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="sb-group">
        <div class="sb-group-label">Trade &amp; connect</div>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="ecommerce"><span>E-Commerce</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="meetings"><span>Meetings</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="streaming"><span>Streaming</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="career"><span>Career</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="blogs"><span>Blogs</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
      </div>
      <div class="sb-group">
        <div class="sb-group-label">Account</div>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="membership"><span>Membership</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="auth"><span>Signup / Login</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
        <button class="sb-link" data-page="contact"><span>Contact</span><span class="dot"></span></button>
      </div>
    </nav>
    <div class="sb-foot"><p>DREAM2BIZ — PROTOTYPE V0.1</p></div>
  </aside>

  <!-- ================= MAIN ================= -->
  <div class="main">
    <header class="topbar">
      <button class="icon-btn mobile-topbar" id="menuToggle" aria-label="Menu"><i class="ti ti-menu-2"></i></button>
      <div class="search-box">
        <i class="ti ti-search"></i>
        <input type="text" id="globalSearch" placeholder="Search courses, products, jobs, people...">
      </div>
      <div class="topbar-spacer"></div>

      <div class="panel-wrap">
        <button class="icon-btn" id="bellBtn" aria-label="Notifications"><i class="ti ti-bell"></i><span class="badge"></span></button>
        <div class="dropdown" id="bellDropdown">
          <div class="dd-head">Notifications</div>
          <div class="dd-body">
            <div class="dd-item"><div class="dd-ic"><i class="ti ti-certificate"></i></div><p><strong>Module complete</strong> — you finished "Intro to Zero-Trust Cyber". Certificate pending.</p></div>
            <div class="dd-item"><div class="dd-ic"><i class="ti ti-message-circle"></i></div><p><strong>New reply</strong> in Community — "Best stack for a first R&D sprint?"</p></div>
            <div class="dd-item"><div class="dd-ic"><i class="ti ti-briefcase"></i></div><p><strong>Job match</strong> on Career — 3 new listings fit your profile.</p></div>
          </div>
          <div style="padding:8px 14px;"><span class="soon">Live notifications coming soon</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="panel-wrap">
        <button class="icon-btn" id="msgBtn" aria-label="Messenger"><i class="ti ti-message-2"></i><span class="badge"></span></button>
        <div class="dropdown" id="msgDropdown">
          <div class="dd-head">Messenger</div>
          <div class="dd-body">
            <div class="dd-item"><div class="dd-ic"><i class="ti ti-user"></i></div><p><strong>Priya S.</strong> — "Sent over the sprint board link, take a look?"</p></div>
            <div class="dd-item"><div class="dd-ic"><i class="ti ti-users"></i></div><p><strong>Bio-AI cohort group</strong> — 4 new messages in forum thread.</p></div>
          </div>
          <div style="padding:8px 14px;"><span class="soon">Chat &amp; video calls coming soon</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="panel-wrap">
        <button class="avatar" id="avatarBtn">D2</button>
        <div class="dropdown" id="profileDropdown" style="width:200px;">
          <div class="dd-body" style="padding:8px;">
            <button class="sb-link" data-page="profile" style="color:var(--muted);">My profile</button>
            <button class="sb-link" data-page="auth" style="color:var(--muted);">Account settings</button>
            <button class="sb-link" data-page="auth" style="color:var(--coral);">Log out</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>

    <main class="content" id="content">

      <!-- ============ HOME ============ -->
      <section class="page active" id="page-home">
        <div class="page-head">
          <div class="eyebrow">The Everything Academy</div>
          <h1>Welcome back — everything you build, learn, sell, and stream lives here.</h1>
          <p>One login for courses, marketplaces, streaming, live meetings, dev sandboxes, and your professional network. Pick up where you left off, or explore something new below.</p>
          <div class="page-actions">
            <button class="btn-primary" data-page="skillup">Continue learning</button>
            <button class="btn-ghost" data-page="membership">View membership plans</button>
          </div>
          <div class="hero-badges">
            <span class="hero-badge">17 active modules</span>
            <span class="hero-badge">1 identity, 1 wallet</span>
            <span class="hero-badge">Prototype build</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="section-sub">
          <h2>Jump back in</h2>
          <div class="grid3">
            <div class="card"><div class="card-ic"><i class="ti ti-school"></i></div><h3>Zero-Trust Cyber Tech</h3><p>Module 4 of 9 — Identity-first architecture</p><button class="btn-sm" data-page="skillup">Resume course</button></div>
            <div class="card"><div class="card-ic"><i class="ti ti-terminal-2"></i></div><h3>R&amp;D Sandbox</h3><p>Sprint board — 3 tasks in progress</p><button class="btn-sm" data-page="rnd">Open sandbox</button></div>
            <div class="card"><div class="card-ic"><i class="ti ti-briefcase"></i></div><h3>Career hub</h3><p>3 new job matches this week</p><button class="btn-sm" data-page="career">View matches</button></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="section-sub">
          <h2>Explore modules</h2>
          <div class="grid3">
            <div class="card"><h3>E-Commerce</h3><p>Retail &amp; B2B trade, storefronts, and bulk sourcing.</p><button class="btn-sm" data-page="ecommerce">Browse</button></div>
            <div class="card"><h3>Streaming</h3><p>On-demand lectures, product demos, and live sessions.</p><button class="btn-sm" data-page="streaming">Watch</button></div>
            <div class="card"><h3>Workspace</h3><p>Docs, meetings, and team spaces in one place.</p><button class="btn-sm" data-page="workspace">Open workspace</button></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ============ NEWSFEED ============ -->
      <section class="page" id="page-newsfeed">
        <div class="page-head">
          <div class="eyebrow">Overview</div>
          <h1>Newsfeed</h1>
          <p>Updates from people you follow, cohorts you're in, and modules you're active in — one feed instead of six.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="row-list">
          <div class="row-item"><div class="row-thumb" style="background:var(--lime-dim);"></div><div><div class="ri-title">Arjun M. shared a project</div><div class="ri-sub">"Sim-to-real transfer for a 2-wheel balancer" — R&amp;D showcase</div></div><div class="ri-right"><span class="soon">Live feed soon</span></div></div>
          <div class="row-item"><div class="row-thumb" style="background:var(--coral-dim);"></div><div><div class="ri-title">Bio-AI cohort — new discussion</div><div class="ri-sub">"Best datasets for protein folding practice?"</div></div><div class="ri-right"><span class="soon">Live feed soon</span></div></div>

<div class="toast" id="toast"><i class="ti ti-clock"></i><span id="toastText">Coming soon</span></div>

<script>
// ---------- navigation ----------
const pages = document.querySelectorAll('.page');
const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('[data-page]');
const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');

function navigate(id){
  pages.forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('active', p.id === 'page-'+id));
  document.querySelectorAll('.sb-link[data-page]').forEach(l => l.classList.toggle('active', l.dataset.page === id));
  closeAllDropdowns();
  sidebar.classList.remove('open');
  window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'smooth'});
  history.replaceState(null, '', '#'+id);
}
navLinks.forEach(el => el.addEventListener('click', () => navigate(el.dataset.page)));

if(location.hash){ navigate(location.hash.slice(1)); }

// ---------- mobile menu ----------
document.getElementById('menuToggle').addEventListener('click', () => sidebar.classList.toggle('open'));

// ---------- dropdowns ----------
const dropdowns = [
  {btn:'bellBtn', dd:'bellDropdown'},
  {btn:'msgBtn', dd:'msgDropdown'},
  {btn:'avatarBtn', dd:'profileDropdown'}
];
function closeAllDropdowns(){ dropdowns.forEach(d => document.getElementById(d.dd).classList.remove('open')); }
dropdowns.forEach(d => {
  document.getElementById(d.btn).addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    const isOpen = document.getElementById(d.dd).classList.contains('open');
    closeAllDropdowns();
    if(!isOpen) document.getElementById(d.dd).classList.add('open');
  });
});
document.addEventListener('click', closeAllDropdowns);
document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown').forEach(dd => dd.addEventListener('click', e => e.stopPropagation()));

// ---------- toast ----------
let toastTimer;
function showToast(msg){
  const t = document.getElementById('toast');
  document.getElementById('toastText').textContent = msg || 'Coming soon — backend in progress';
  t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(toastTimer);
  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 2600);
}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-toast]').forEach(el => {
  el.addEventListener('click', () => showToast(el.dataset.toast));
});

// ---------- auth tabs ----------
const tabLogin = document.getElementById('tabLogin');
const tabSignup = document.getElementById('tabSignup');
const fieldName = document.getElementById('fieldName');
const authSubmit = document.getElementById('authSubmit');
tabLogin.addEventListener('click', () => {
  tabLogin.classList.add('active'); tabSignup.classList.remove('active');
  fieldName.style.display = 'none'; authSubmit.textContent = 'Log in';
});
tabSignup.addEventListener('click', () => {
  tabSignup.classList.add('active'); tabLogin.classList.remove('active');
  fieldName.style.display = 'block'; authSubmit.textContent = 'Create account';
});
document.getElementById('authForm').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  showToast('Authentication backend coming soon');
});
document.getElementById('contactForm').addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  showToast('Message sending coming soon');
});

// ---------- global search ----------
const searchMap = {
  'course':'skillup','courses':'skillup','learn':'skillup','tutorial':'tutorials',
  'book':'elibrary','library':'elibrary','sandbox':'rnd','r&d':'rnd','rnd':'rnd',
  'software':'software','product':'software','service':'digiservices','digi':'digiservices',
  'doc':'workspace','sheet':'workspace','meeting':'workspace','shop':'ecommerce','buy':'ecommerce',
  'sell':'ecommerce','cart':'ecommerce','zoom':'meetings','call':'meetings','video':'streaming',
  'watch':'streaming','stream':'streaming','job':'career','career':'career','linkedin':'career',
  'blog':'blogs','article':'blogs','plan':'membership','pricing':'membership','membership':'membership',
  'login':'auth','signup':'auth','sign up':'auth','contact':'contact','support':'contact','profile':'profile'
};
document.getElementById('globalSearch').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if(e.key === 'Enter'){
    const q = e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const match = Object.keys(searchMap).find(k => q.includes(k));
    if(match){ navigate(searchMap[match]); e.target.value=''; }
    else{ showToast('No results yet — search index coming soon'); }
  }
});
</script>
